rules: Don't edit scripts/qa-ui.mjs or tests/, skip a test or loosen a pass rule to get through the gate.
Before ending a turn on visual work, look at the changed screens at 1440px and 375px and run the unslop pass for UI or wording (DESIGN.md, VOICE.md).
The local build reads the worktree's copy of data/, so it never touches real data. Never approve, send, apply or fetch from the UI.
Never commit or print .env.local, credentials/, config/applyKit.json, data/, resumes/ or logs/.
Never push main, run sync.sh or publish. The owner reviews the PR, then syncs main to hosted with ./scripts/sync.sh.
